guards.title: Escape inside the open access menu closes only the menu
guards.goal: The first Escape closes the menu and keeps the dialog open

plan.root_cause: The dropdown's keydown handler calls event.stopPropagation() for Escape, preventing the modal's escape listener from receiving the event and thus the modal does not close.
plan.repair_strategy: Modify Dropdown.dataApiKeydownHandler to prevent default for Escape but only stop propagation for non‑Escape keys, allowing the event to bubble to the modal while still closing the dropdown menu.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Pressing Escape while focus is on the access toggle button will now close the share modal, making the button invisible as required.
functional_risks: Potential change to dropdown Escape behavior if other scripts rely on the event not propagating.
Ensuring that arrow keys and Space still work correctly within the dropdown after the conditional stopPropagation.
verification_requirements: Verify that Escape closes the modal when focus is on the access toggle button.
Verify that the dropdown menu closes when Escape is pressed.
Verify that Escape still closes the dropdown when the modal is not open.
Verify that ArrowUp, ArrowDown, and Space keys still function correctly inside the dropdown.
Verify that modal closing via Escape works when focus is elsewhere inside the modal.

plan.root_cause: The modal's Escape key handler closes the dialog even when the Escape key is pressed inside an open dropdown menu. The event bubbles from the dropdown menu item up to the modal element, triggering the modal's keydown listener before the dropdown's delegated handler can close only the menu.
plan.repair_strategy: Modify the modal's Escape key handler to ignore Escape events that originate from within an open dropdown menu (element with class 'dropdown-menu.show'). This allows the dropdown's own Escape handling to close the menu while keeping the modal open. When focus is on the dropdown toggle button (outside the menu), the modal will still close as required.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Pressing Escape while focus is on the access toggle button closes the share dialog. Pressing Escape while focus is inside the open dropdown menu closes only the dropdown menu, leaving the dialog open.
functional_risks: If other components use the same dropdown menu markup inside modals, they will also be prevented from closing on Escape.
The selector '.dropdown-menu.show' relies on Bootstrap's internal class names; if the dropdown implementation changes, this may need updating.
verification_requirements: Verify Escape closes the modal when focus is on the access toggle button.
Verify Escape closes only the dropdown menu when focus is on a dropdown menu item.
Verify that after closing the dropdown menu with Escape, focus returns to the access toggle button.
Verify that the modal can still be closed by Escape when focus is elsewhere in the modal (e.g., on the Cancel button).
Verify that the regression guard 'Escape inside the open access menu closes only the menu' passes.

plan.root_cause: The dropdown's keydown handler calls event.stopPropagation() for all dropdown commands, including Escape. When focus is on the access toggle button (the dropdown toggle), pressing Escape triggers the dropdown handler, which stops propagation, preventing the modal's Escape handler from receiving the event and closing the dialog.
plan.repair_strategy: Modify the dropdown's dataApiKeydownHandler to conditionally stop propagation: only stop propagation for Escape if the event originates from within the dropdown menu (i.e., event.target.closest('.dropdown-menu')). This allows Escape pressed on the dropdown toggle button to bubble to the modal, closing the dialog, while preserving the behavior that Escape inside the open dropdown menu closes only the menu.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Pressing Escape while focus is on the access toggle button will close the share dialog, making the button invisible. Pressing Escape while focus is inside the open dropdown menu will close only the menu, leaving the dialog open.
functional_risks: If other components rely on the dropdown's Escape key stopping propagation globally, they may receive the event unexpectedly.
The selector '.dropdown-menu' relies on Bootstrap's internal class name; if the dropdown implementation changes, this may need updating.
verification_requirements: Verify Escape closes the modal when focus is on the access toggle button.
Verify Escape closes only the dropdown menu when focus is on a dropdown menu item.
Verify that after closing the dropdown menu with Escape, focus returns to the access toggle button.
Verify that the modal can still be closed by Escape when focus is elsewhere in the modal (e.g., on the Cancel button).
Verify that the regression guard 'Escape inside the open access menu closes only the menu' passes.
